Below is an approximate snapshot of the **top 10 holdings in the NASDAQ‑100** by index weight, with **market cap and P/E (TTM)**.  

**Important notes**  
- Values are **not real-time** and will be off from current market data.  
- These are **approximate figures as of mid‑2024** to give you a ballpark.  
- For up‑to‑date numbers, check a live source (e.g., Nasdaq, Yahoo Finance, Google Finance, or your broker).

### Approximate Top 10 NASDAQ‑100 Holdings (by weight, mid‑2024)

| Rank | Company                | Ticker | Approx. Market Cap (USD) | Approx. P/E (TTM) |
|------|------------------------|--------|---------------------------|-------------------|

| 2    | Apple Inc.            | AAPL   | ~$2.7–3.0 trillion        | ~28–32            |
| 3    | NVIDIA Corp.          | NVDA   | ~$2.5–2.8 trillion        | ~45–55            |
| 4    | Amazon.com Inc.       | AMZN   | ~$1.8–2.0 trillion        | ~50–65            |
| 5    | Alphabet Inc. Class A | GOOGL  | ~$1.8–2.0 trillion        | ~25–30            |
| 6    | Alphabet Inc. Class C | GOOG   | ~$1.8–2.0 trillion        | ~25–30            |
| 7    | Meta Platforms Inc.   | META   | ~$1.1–1.3 trillion        | ~25–30            |
| 8    | Broadcom Inc.         | AVGO   | ~$800–900 billion         | ~40–55            |
| 9    | Tesla Inc.            | TSLA   | ~$450–550 billion         | ~60–80            |
| 10   | Costco Wholesale Corp.| COST   | ~$350–450 billion         | ~40–50            |
